messages:
alex: standup — GPU scaling / provisioning check
What I did: validated last night's autoscale jobs and drained 3 preemptible nodes in us-west2.
Blockers: eu-west1 quota still low; trying to get GCP quota increase but need justification.
Today: open ticket for quota, finish terraform fix for node pool name collision, review PR #412.

maria: Thanks! FYI I filed the GCP quota request this morning — https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/quotas?project=redwood-inference ticket: QUO-7821
They asked for expected peak QPS and bin size, I replied with our projection doc.

jonathan: On the terraform side: found the bug. node_pool_name is being generated with a random suffix causing drift during apply.
Quick patch: replace
`module.gke.node_pool_name = format("%s-%s", var.cluster, substr(md5(var.cluster),0,6))`
with
`node_pool_name = var.cluster`
Will open PR with migration steps.

samira: Capacity note: projected 3-day peak for us-west2 = 92% GPU utilization if we push the new model. eu-west1 will hit 88% without extra quota.
Recommend we enable burst pools in dedicated for canary.

infra-bot: automated-alert: quota_utilization eu-west1 GPUs = 85% (threshold 80%). See dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/quota-eu-west1

alex: @maria @jonathan @samira Thanks. Action items: Maria - follow up on QUO-7821 with the expected QPS numbers if you haven't; Jonathan - open PR + run terraform plan in staging; Samira - schedule canary burst for tomorrow AM. I'll own the rollout window. :thumbsup:

maria: On it. I'll ping the GCP rep after adding numbers. ETA 45m.

jonathan: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/417
Plan shows 2 node replacements and no downtime. I'll run a dry-run in staging at 10:30 PT.

samira: Scheduled canary burst 09:00 PT tomorrow. Added runbook steps to the ticket.

alex: :raised_hands: Good. If eu-west1 quota doesn't increase by EOD, we'll route early canaries to us-west2 and enable burst.
